about: Data for scripts/df_article.py lint. Each entry: id, severity (error|warning), kinds (article|proposal|response), lang (en|ru|*), where (any|start = sentence start), patterns (Python regex, case-insensitive unless case=true), why, fix, source. Severity is calibrated so that references/2725.md has zero errors. Add an entry only for a pattern observed in a real agent text or documented in WP:AISIGNS; keep the incident in source.

entries.why: The current proposal style describes the client's system, not the client; older examples do not override the later explicit correction.
entries.fix: Name the technical subject: the website, the form, the container or the event. Preserve exact source/UI quotations.
entries.source: adorncroft req/16; anti-slop user clarification 2026-10-20: the website instead of your website

patterns: (?:However|Furthermore|Moreover|Additionally|In addition(?!\s+to)|Consequently|As a result(?!\s+of)|In contrast(?!\s+to)|Notably|Importantly|Crucially|Overall|Ultimately|Thus|Therefore|Hence|Meanwhile|Indeed|Essentially|Interestingly|At the same time|On the other hand|That said|Similarly|Likewise|Accordingly|Subsequently|To summarize|In summary|In conclusion)\b
entries.why: A sentence-initial connective replaces a reference to the premise with rhetoric; the reader cannot check which paragraph the inference rests on.
entries.fix: Make the premise its own numbered paragraph and write the conclusion as `**[§N](#P.N)** → conclusion`; if the sentence adds a new fact, drop the connective and keep the fact.
entries.source: WP:AIVOCAB (Additionally); proactivsports draft.prev.md: Consequently/Furthermore/However/In contrast/As a result; materaprima draft.md §5.2 «At the same time»

entries.why: «Because X, Y» packs a premise and a conclusion into one sentence; X is then neither numbered nor proven.
entries.fix: Split: X becomes a numbered observation with its proof, Y becomes `**[§X]** → Y`.

entries.why: An inline inference word hides the step instead of exposing its premises.
entries.fix: Express the step with `→` after explicit premise references.

entries.why: Narrating the auditor's process instead of stating the fact; the proof is the command, not the story of looking.
entries.fix: State the fact as the subject-verb sentence and attach the command or link that proves it.
entries.source: proactivsports res/4 (self-reported: «Inspection of ... shows that», «reveals that»); materaprima draft.md:390

entries.why: Words that LLMs overuse statistically; they carry no fact about this website.
entries.fix: Delete the word; if a fact remains, state it with the plain verb (is, has, sends, returns).

entries.why: Puffing up importance instead of stating the consequence for this client.
entries.fix: Name the concrete consequence and its premise, or delete the sentence.

entries.why: The format has no recap sections: every conclusion already has its own numbered paragraph.
entries.fix: Delete the recap; reference the paragraph instead.
entries.source: WP:AISIGNS «Section summaries»; materaprima res/6 «## 12. Synthesis of the Five Analytical Stages»

entries.why: Sales and chat-assistant phrases; the client hires for the proof, not the tone.
entries.fix: Delete; let the numbered evidence speak.

entries.why: LLMs avoid plain «is/has»; the replacement verb adds nothing.
entries.fix: Use «is», «has», or the specific technical verb.

entries.why: A trailing participle clause appends an unproven «analysis» to a fact.
entries.fix: If the consequence is real, give it its own paragraph with `→`; otherwise delete the clause.

entries.why: A rhetorical contrast against a claim nobody made.
entries.fix: State the positive fact once.

entries.why: An intensifier claims more than the evidence; the number or the premise must carry the weight.
entries.fix: Delete it or replace it with the measured quantity.
entries.source: proactivsports res/4 (self-reported: completely, solely, exclusively); materaprima draft.md §5.4 «zero visibility»

entries.why: An evaluation without its premise; in 2725 an evaluation appears only as the conclusion of listed premises (§14.3).
entries.fix: Move the evaluation behind `→` after the premises, or replace it with the measured effect.
entries.source: proactivsports res/4 (Critical, Fragile, brittle, spurious, dead-end)

entries.why: Vague attribution or wordy filler where a direct statement exists.
entries.fix: Name the source with a link, or use the short form (to, use, that).
entries.source: WP:AIWEASEL, WP:AICONNECT, WP:AISIGNS «Signs of human writing»

entries.why: Internal KB or rule identifiers mean nothing to the client.
entries.fix: Replace with the fact itself and its public proof.

entries.why: Paths of the agent knowledge base are not accessible to the client.
entries.fix: Prove the fact with a command the client can run, a public URL or a quote.

entries.why: Internal capture fingerprints are not client-facing proof; a hash used by the actual application may be relevant.
entries.fix: Remove service fingerprints from the prose; show repeatable equality evidence if needed. Retain a real application hashing mechanism when it answers the client task.
entries.source: materaprima req/4: Why do you state the byte count and SHA-256 for HTTP 404?

entries.why: An exact byte count is justified only when the size itself proves a conclusion (page weight).
entries.fix: Delete unless a paragraph concludes something from this size.

entries.why: The F/H/M analysis template (DOC-2/DOC-3) is an internal working form; the article states only proven facts and conclusions.
entries.fix: Keep a hypothesis only if the client must act on it; phrase it once as «probable» with its premise (2725 §24.3).
entries.source: materaprima res/6 «Synthesis… Arguments for / Arguments against / Limitation»

patterns: (?:Кроме того|Более того|Помимо этого|Таким образом|Следовательно|Поэтому|В итоге|В заключение|Итак|Однако|При этом|Вместе с тем|В свою очередь|Важно отметить|Стоит отметить|Следует отметить|Необходимо отметить|Тем не менее)\b
entries.why: Connective used instead of a premise reference.
entries.fix: Make the premise a separate numbered item and write the conclusion as **[§N](#P.N)** → conclusion.

patterns: (?:Кроме того|Более того|Помимо этого|Таким образом|В итоге|В заключение|Итак|Важно отметить|Стоит отметить|Следует отметить|Необходимо отметить)\b
entries.why: Filler connective.
entries.fix: Remove the connective and keep the fact.

entries.why: Hidden inference step.
entries.fix: Express the inference step with → after premise references.

entries.why: Empty significance claim.
entries.fix: State the concrete consequence or remove.

entries.why: Intensifier used instead of a measured quantity.
entries.fix: Remove or replace with a measured value.

entries.why: A conditional clause placed after the imperative action disguises hesitation and hedges against facts; recommendations must be direct or use the canonical prefix form «If X → do Y» branching from an audit step (§II.12.2).
entries.fix: Verify the condition against evidence; remove the trailing condition for verified facts, or structure as an explicit branch following a diagnostic step.
entries.source: shakhshop req/4 draft.md §II.1.2: Submit an appeal in Meta Business Support Home if the catalog products do not constitute religious practices

entries.why: Procedural report about what the agent preserved or left untouched instead of the substantive result; the user does not need rule IDs.
entries.fix: Report the result and what remains unverified; keep service receipts in ꘖ/data.
entries.source: WP:AISIGNS Specific mentions of preserved/retained information; materaprima res/4 (SCOPE-2, backup snapshot), res/4-6 Limitation:
